home.title: ISL Connect
home.intro: Choose what you want to do.

signToText.title: Sign → Text
signToText.description: Point the camera at a signer to see text.

textToIsl.title: Text → ISL
textToIsl.description: Type a phrase to see how it is signed.

history.title: History
history.description: Recent results saved on this phone.

home.disclaimer: Early version. This app is not a replacement for a qualified ISL interpreter.

outputLanguage.label: Output and speech language
outputLanguage.hint: Language for recognised text and spoken output.

autoSpeak.label: Speak results automatically
autoSpeak.hint: When off, tap Speak to hear a result.

history.label: Save history on this phone
history.hint: Off by default. History never leaves this phone. Turning this off deletes saved history.

haptics.label: Vibrate when a sign is recognised

demoMode.label: Demo mode
demoMode.hint: Shows simulated results to demonstrate the app. It does not recognise real signs.

about.limitations: Sign recognition is not available yet: no recognition model has been trained. ISL demonstrations will be added only after review by qualified ISL educators.
about.notInterpreter: This app is not a replacement for a qualified ISL interpreter, especially for medical, legal or emergency situations.
about.privacy: Camera video stays on your phone. It is never recorded or uploaded.

resetProgress.label: Reset learning progress
resetProgress.confirmMessage: This clears lessons marked as learned and quiz results on this phone.

theme.label: Appearance
theme.hint: System follows your phone's light or dark setting.

modelUnavailable.title: Sign recognition is not available yet
modelUnavailable.message: No recognition model has been trained yet, so this app cannot read signs. You can try demo mode to see how this screen works. Demo results are simulated.

modelError.title: Sign recognition stopped working
modelError.message: Something went wrong with the recognition model. Please try again.

permission.title: Camera access needed
permission.message: The camera is used to see the signer. Video stays on this phone. It is never recorded or uploaded.
permission.deniedMessage: To use Sign → Text, allow camera access for ISL Connect in your phone settings.

cameraError.title: Camera not available
cameraError.message: The camera could not start. Another app may be using it, or this device may not have a camera.

simulated.title: Demo mode: simulated results
simulated.message: These results do not come from the camera. This is not real sign recognition.

signToText.framing: Position the signer inside the frame. Keep both hands and the upper body visible.

status.noSigner: No signer in view. Position the signer inside the frame.
status.uncertain: Not sure what was signed. Please try again.

hints.low_confidence: Try signing a little more slowly, with hands clearly in view.
hints.ambiguous: It could be more than one sign.
hints.unknown_sign: This sign may not be in the app's vocabulary yet.

result.label: Last recognised
result.emergency: Emergency-related sign. If someone needs urgent help, call 112.

transcript.label: Signs recognised so far
transcript.note: Separate signs in the order they were recognised. This is not a translated sentence.

speech.unsupported: No {{language}} voice is installed on this phone, so the text is only shown on screen. You can add a voice in your phone's text-to-speech settings.
speech.engineUnavailable: Speech is not available on this phone. The text is shown on screen.
speech.error: Could not speak. Please try again.

history.disabledMessage: Turn on “Save history on this phone” in Settings to keep recent results. History never leaves this phone.
history.emptyMessage: Recognised signs and phrases you look up will appear here.
history.privacyNote: Saved only on this phone. Demo mode results are never saved.
history.confirmMessage: This deletes all saved history on this phone. It cannot be undone.

textToIsl.scopeNotice: This looks up words and common phrases in the ISL sign library. It does not translate full sentences: ISL has its own grammar.
textToIsl.empty: Type a word or phrase first.
textToIsl.ambiguous: This can mean more than one sign. Choose the one that fits what you mean.
textToIsl.noMatchTitle: Not in the sign library yet
textToIsl.noMatchMessage: This phrase has not been added to the library. Try a shorter or simpler phrase.
textToIsl.relatedTitle: Signs for parts of your text
textToIsl.relatedWarning: These are separate signs. Putting them together is not a translation of your sentence.

demonstration.unavailableMessage: A video of this sign will be added after qualified ISL educators have reviewed it.
demonstration.pendingPlayer: A verified demonstration exists, but video playback is not built yet.

learn.contentNotice: Lessons are being prepared with qualified ISL educators. Sign demonstrations appear only after they have been verified.

lesson.phraseNoGloss: A phrase made of several signs. The sign order will come from ISL educators.
lesson.unverified: This sign has not been reviewed by ISL educators yet. Please do not learn it from this app until it is verified.
lesson.markLearnedDisabled: You can mark this sign as learned once its demonstration is available.
lesson.practiceUnavailable: Practice with the camera will be available when sign recognition is ready.

quiz.unavailable: Quizzes use only signs with verified demonstrations. There are not enough in this category yet.
quiz.question: What does this sign mean?

feedback.privacyWarning: Please do not include names, phone numbers, addresses or other personal details. No photos or video are sent.
feedback.included: App version {{version}}, {{platform}} {{os}}, app language {{appLanguage}}, output language {{outputLanguage}}.
feedback.sendHint: Sends this report over the internet to the project's server.
feedback.offline: No internet connection. The report was not sent. You can share it instead.
feedback.failed: The report could not be sent. You can share it instead.

diagram.a11y: Hand diagram of the sign for {{text}}
diagram.missingSign: Teach this sign once and its diagram will appear here.
diagram.missingLetter: Record this letter in Learn → Alphabet to fingerspell it.
